name: SUCCESSOR_KEY_MODULE
description: Successor key module: stores one successor key as a salted hash and verifies a presented key against it.

harness.purpose: Successor key module: stores one successor key as a salted hash and verifies a presented key against it.
harness.reason: the agent stores and verifies a secret key: set_successor_key and verify take the key as an argument, so every use would pass the secret through a model, and the other methods only report that a key exists. Use it from code or the security admin console, not through a model.
